02 CREATOR SESSION

Film your next YouTube video.

Some videos need a clean shot of the presenter. Others only make sense when the viewer can see your hands. Tell us what you’re teaching and we’ll work out where to put the cameras before you unpack.

Plan a YouTube shoot ↗Session rates ↗

01 SESSION NOTES

Show the detail your viewer needs to see.

01

A desk or a demo bench

Use the presenter desk for a straight-to-camera introduction or an interview. For a product walkthrough, leave space on the bench and frame a close shot of the part you’re explaining.

02

Bring a running order

A list of steps is enough. Mark the bits that need a close-up and bring the actual items you’ll use. A barber showing a clipper adjustment needs a very different framing from someone demonstrating software.

03

Record a series in one visit

If you’re filming a few short videos, send us the outlines first. We can keep the lighting and framing consistent and agree how long to allow for resets. Multiple edited videos are quoted by the deliverables.

02 BEFORE YOU RECORD

Good questions.

Is this a room I can use to film my own channel?

Yes. This is a physical recording space in Limassol for filming YouTube videos. You can plan an assisted shoot or discuss self-service after an induction.

Can I get a vertical version as well?

Tell us before filming so there’s room to crop the shot. The proposed rate for an edited vertical clip is €35.
